overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board's unanimous votes on pre-distributed motions, with no discussion at a two-minute meeting, did not show it deliberated outside a noticed meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board deliberated on police disciplinary motions outside a noticed meeting, pointing to the lack of discussion at the March 9, 2017 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We have stated in a prior determination that unanimous agreement among public body members is insufficient to support the inference that those members deliberated outside of a noticed meeting.
